tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the user's Gmail and return matching messages as a compact list (id, from, subject, date, snippet). Use Gmail's own query syntax, e.g. "is:unread", "from:anna newer_than:7d", "has:attachment invoice".

query.description: Gmail search query, e.g. is:unread from:anna

limit.description: How many messages to return (default 10, at most 25)

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read one Gmail message in full: headers and the plain-text body. Takes an id from gmail_search.

id.description: The message id returned by gmail_search

tools.name: labels
tools.description: List the names of the user's Gmail labels and mailboxes, so a search can be scoped to one with label:<name>.
